# Nexiora AI

> Nexiora AI is an AI chatbot platform for businesses: it answers website visitor questions, qualifies leads, captures contact details, and books appointments — trained on each business's own content.

Nexiora AI is built for small and medium businesses, agencies, consultants, and service businesses that want to convert website traffic into qualified leads and booked appointments without manual follow-up. Each chatbot is trained only on the business's own documents, FAQs, and website content, and answers only from what it has been given rather than guessing.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://nexiora-ai.app/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://nexiora-ai.app/#pricing): Starter, Growth, Business, and Enterprise plans.
- [FAQ](https://nexiora-ai.app/#faq): Common questions about setup, training, and billing.

## Key features

- 24/7 AI conversations trained on the business's own content
- Automatic lead capture (name, email, requirements)
- In-widget appointment booking
- Knowledge base training from documents, FAQs, and website content
- Human handoff for conversations the AI can't resolve
- Conversation and lead analytics per chatbot

## Setup

A business creates a chatbot, trains it on their own content, and embeds a single script tag on their site — no coding required beyond that.
